title: Majestic Win
reviewNotes: Three short branches begin at the seven-piece Rxa4+ diagram at 169s with White Kg4. Kg5 is the unique win-preserving move; the source Ra5+ Kh6 reply ends at an exact White win while the a6 pawn limits the checking ladder. Independent Kf5 and Kh5 comparisons draw. Earlier nine-piece rook walk, g1 rook sacrifice and eight-piece knight-underpromotion phase remain source context; no complete later conversion is asserted.
